questions.question: True or False: Michu scored 18 Premier League goals for Swansea City during his debut 2012–13 season.
questions.explanation: Michu scored 18 Premier League goals in 35 appearances for Swansea City during the 2012–13 season.

questions.question: Which manager led newly promoted Ipswich Town to a 5th-place finish in the 2000–01 Premier League season?
questions.explanation: George Burley guided Ipswich Town to 5th place with 66 points in the 2000–01 season, winning the Premier League Manager of the Season award.

questions.question: Which player scored the fastest hat-trick in Premier League history, taking just 2 minutes and 56 seconds for Southampton against Aston Villa in May 2015?
questions.explanation: Sadio Mané scored three goals in 2 minutes and 56 seconds during Southampton's 6–1 victory over Aston Villa on 16 May 2015.

questions.question: Who was the first player to score four goals in a single Premier League match for Tottenham Hotspur, achieving the feat against Wimbledon in May 1998?
questions.explanation: Jürgen Klinsmann scored four goals in Tottenham Hotspur's 6–2 away win over Wimbledon at Selhurst Park on 2 May 1998.

questions.question: Which Arsenal player scored all four of his team's goals in a 4–4 Premier League draw against Liverpool at Anfield in April 2009?
questions.explanation: Andrey Arshavin scored four goals at Anfield on 21 April 2009 during a thrilling 4–4 draw between Liverpool and Arsenal.

questions.question: Which manager led West Ham United to a 5th-place Premier League finish in the 1998–99 season, their highest-ever finish in the Premier League era?
questions.explanation: Harry Redknapp guided West Ham United to 5th place in the 1998–99 Premier League season, securing 57 points.

questions.question: Which Brazilian midfielder scored a long-range 30-yard swerving goal to help Hull City earn a 2–1 Premier League victory against Arsenal at the Emirates Stadium in September 2008?
questions.explanation: Geovanni scored a dramatic equalizer from long range at the Emirates Stadium on 27 September 2008 as Hull City went on to win 2–1.

questions.question: In March 2007, which Tottenham Hotspur goalkeeper scored a Premier League goal from an 87-metre free-kick against Watford?
questions.explanation: Paul Robinson scored directly from a long bounce free-kick against Watford goalkeeper Ben Foster on 17 March 2007.

questions.question: Which midfielder recorded 20 Premier League assists in the 2019–20 season, equalling the single-season assist record?
questions.explanation: Kevin De Bruyne registered 20 Premier League assists for Manchester City during the 2019–20 season.

questions.question: Which manager took charge of Derby County during the 2007–08 season when they set the record for the lowest points total in Premier League history with 11 points?
questions.explanation: Paul Jewell managed Derby County for the majority of the 2007–08 season, finishing with a record-low total of 11 points.
